answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 10213 Country: India Title: Assalamualaikum, Can a boy marry a girl who is richer than him , if the girl agrees for the marriage and keeps her mahr less as compared to mahr of other girls of her family? Question: Assalamualaikum, Can a boy marry a girl who is richer than him , if the girl agrees for the marriage and keeps her mahr less as compared to mahr of other girls of her family? Answer ID: 10213 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 107/79=H/1429) In the above-mentioned case, the Nikah is valid if there is no valid reason preventing Nikah and the Nikah is performed with the mediation of their guardians in proper way. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
